reason: PC-GNN completed two verified GPU training epochs on T-Finance via a single-relation homogeneous adapter, using the team-frozen stratified split. Two source-code registrations were required: (1) a load_data() branch in utils.py to read TFinance.mat plus the single-relation adjacency-list pickles (repeated across the homo/relation1-3 slots since PC-GNN's original code always expects 4 relation structures), and (2) an eligible_index branch in unified_model_handler.py declaring all T-Finance nodes eligible for supervised splits, since T-Finance has no unlabeled-node structure unlike Amazon. Neither change altered the PC-GNN architecture, loss, Pick-and-Choose sampling, or relation aggregators themselves.
